premises.text: SMBs miss large energy-cost savings because they do not organize and analyze energy data the way large firms do
premises.evidence_span: most large businesses organized and analyzed their energy data and managed it well and paid less for it. But small and medium-sized users didn't

premises.text: Energy Elephant builds, visualizes, and analyzes energy data from uploaded bills
premises.evidence_span: helping businesses build, visualize, and analyze their energy data

premises.text: Product shows five-year cost projections and cost, consumption, and carbon breakdowns with year comparisons
premises.evidence_span: his cost for the next five years

premises.text: Weather overlays and automated warnings detect wasteful patterns such as overheating
premises.evidence_span: We can even show Sean how the weather is affecting his energy use

premises.text: Peer benchmarks and supplier comparisons surface consumption and tariff savings
premises.evidence_span: we compare it against other suppliers to see what opportunities for savings are available

premises.text: Anyone can use free bill upload; paying customers get deeper ongoing analysis for under £1/day/site
premises.evidence_span: Anybody can use the Energy Elephant system. for free if they have an energy bill
